items.name: watsonx-langflow-integration
items.description: This tutorial presents a complete and structured guide to integrating IBM watsonx.ai foundation models into the Langflow visual programming environment using custom components. You will learn how to install Langflow, configure IBM watsonx.ai, develop chatbot and agent flows, and incorporate vector-based Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).

items.name: ADVANCED-Python-AI-Multi-Agent-Tutorial-RAG-Streamlit-Langflow-
items.description: A hands-on guide to building multi-agent AI systems using Python. Learn to implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for context-aware responses, create interactive UIs with Streamlit, and design agent workflows with Langflow. Includes practical demos, prompt engineering, and real-world use cases.
